lines: Something odd? See exactly what Wattzup hears from the bike.
The pulse icon in the app bar opens Diagnostics, right over the ride.
It lists what Wattzup sees right now: the server and its viewers, the Bluetooth link and the device.
The transport, the packet count, how long it's been live, the last update and the last error.
Below them, the latest raw packets, straight from the packet log.
Copy details puts all of it on the clipboard as plain text, ready for a bug report.
If the server drops, the first row says so: Offline, retrying every two seconds.
On a phone, the dialog fits the screen.
What the tests prove: every notification from the bike is appended to the raw packet log.
And Copy details copies the values and the packets, nothing more.
That is journey twelve. Wattzup turns an Echelon bike into a live training display.
